Package neqsim.process.dynamics

Class TransientErrorStateVector

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.dynamics.TransientErrorStateVector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class TransientErrorStateVector extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, identity-sorted state vector for a deterministic maximum normalized trial error.

Comparison requires exactly matching owner/variable identities, unit labels and tolerances. Values are not converted between units. Arithmetic overflow yields positive infinity so a trial is rejected rather than accidentally accepted with a NaN or a zero error.

Version:
1.0
Author:

    • compareTo

      public TransientErrorStateVector.ErrorEstimate compareTo(TransientErrorStateVector other)
      Computes the unextrapolated maximum normalized full-versus-half difference.

      For each scalar, error is absolute value difference divided by the absolute tolerance plus relative tolerance times the larger absolute value. Equal maxima select the lexically first identity.

      Parameters:
      other - state vector from the alternate trial
      Returns:
      maximum normalized difference and its limiting variable
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if vector identities, units or tolerance policies differ
